name: daily-board
description: A daily must-do board above the prompt: up to three goals plus your own counters, toggles and checklists, one colored status line that expands into a card. Optional gate that locks build tools until the counters are met.

goal_name.title: Goal name
goal_name.description: What a daily goal is called, for example MIT, Goal or Focus. It is also the slash command that sets goals: MIT gives /mit.

goal_slots.title: Goal slots
goal_slots.description: How many goals you can set per day, 0 to 3. Only the goals set for the day are shown.

marker.title: Progress marker
marker.description: How counter progress is drawn: square, circle or bar.

gate.title: Lock build tools until counters are met
gate.description: On weekdays, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit and Bash are refused until every counter has reached its target. Typing OVERRIDE and a reason opens the gate for the rest of the day.
